BRS1-FM4-PM8.action: Consider structured ketogenic approaches only in specific clinical contexts
BRS1-FM4-PM8.explanation: to increase reliance on ketone metabolism and fuel-adaptation pathways where clinically indicated; not a general population recommendation.
BRS1-FM4-PM8.context: Downstream cross-BRS relationship through altered ketone/substrate metabolism and carbon contribution to GABA formation.

evidence.limitation: No demonstrated human GAD-activity or GABA synthesis-flux effect; human concentration evidence is inconsistent.
